title: Ban Appeal Extended.

replies.author: PH_Msus
replies.body: All of the things i said were true, I never abused the system and used other accounts to play while i was banned. All of those accounts belong to individual people. I know what i did was wrong (Hacking). That's why i made an appeal to apologize for what i have done. Now i know that people don't believe things and are trying to not get me unbanned so any of my friends that want to come over and play at my house, i will simply tell them no because it will be too suspicious, so please hear me out and pardon me this one last time. I do know that this is my last strike and if anything happens again my appeal will be automatically denied.
